scripts.test: pnpm --filter api test && pnpm --filter api test:e2e && pnpm --filter web test
scripts.e2e: concurrently --kill-others --success command-tests --names postgres,tests "docker compose up postgres" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5432 && pnpm e2e:scenarios"
scripts.e2e:scenarios: pnpm e2e:success && pnpm e2e:scripted && pnpm e2e:paused
scripts.e2e:api:success: cross-env DATABASE_URL=postgresql://casecellshop:casecellshop@127.0.0.1:5432/casecellshop_test DATABASE_URL_TEST=postgresql://casecellshop:casecellshop@127.0.0.1:5432/casecellshop WORKER_POLL_MS=50 ERP_SIMULATION_DELAY_MS=750 ERP_SIMULATION_MODE=success ERP_SIMULATION_SCRIPT=failure,success pnpm --filter api start
scripts.e2e:api:scripted: cross-env DATABASE_URL=postgresql://casecellshop:casecellshop@127.0.0.1:5432/casecellshop_test DATABASE_URL_TEST=postgresql://casecellshop:casecellshop@127.0.0.1:5432/casecellshop WORKER_POLL_MS=50 ERP_SIMULATION_DELAY_MS=500 ERP_SIMULATION_MODE=scripted ERP_SIMULATION_SCRIPT=failure,success pnpm --filter api start
scripts.e2e:api:paused: cross-env DATABASE_URL=postgresql://casecellshop:casecellshop@127.0.0.1:5432/casecellshop_test DATABASE_URL_TEST=postgresql://casecellshop:casecellshop@127.0.0.1:5432/casecellshop WORKER_POLL_MS=50 ERP_SIMULATION_DELAY_MS=32000 ERP_SIMULATION_MODE=success ERP_SIMULATION_SCRIPT=failure,success pnpm --filter api start
scripts.e2e:success: pnpm db:reset:test && concurrently --kill-others --success command-test --names api,web,test "pnpm e2e:api:success" "pnpm e2e:web" "wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:3001/api/health http-get://127.0.0.1:3000 && playwright test --grep @success"
scripts.e2e:scripted: pnpm db:reset:test && concurrently --kill-others --success command-test --names api,web,test "pnpm e2e:api:scripted" "pnpm e2e:web" "wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:3001/api/health http-get://127.0.0.1:3000 && playwright test --grep @scripted"
scripts.e2e:paused: pnpm db:reset:test && concurrently --kill-others --success command-test --names api,web,test "pnpm e2e:api:paused" "pnpm e2e:web" "wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:3001/api/health http-get://127.0.0.1:3000 && playwright test --grep @paused"
